title: agent-context-30: Extend agent-context JSON to 30/30 entries
description: Feature P1-8. vb_cli/src/agent_context/mod.rs:103-261 has 22 `command(...)` literals in the commands() function. The agent-context JSON is the AI-native control plane (master §75) — it enumerates every CLI command an AI agent can invoke. Master §33.3 Lifecycle Command Surface lists 14+ commands; the current 22 are missing 8: help, version, status, system status, action list, action inspect, ai-context, cancel. Proptest in crates/vb_cli/src/agent_context/tests/properties.rs:208-216 asserts commands.len() == 22 and will fail when the count is bumped to 30. This bead: (1) adds the 8 missing command(...) literals; (2) updates the proptest constant to 30.

ubiquitous: THE SYSTEM SHALL expose every CLI command listed in master §33.3 in the agent-context JSON
THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the agent-context command count equal to the number of distinct CLI subcommands

event_driven.trigger: WHEN the user runs `vb agent-context --deliver stdout`
event_driven.shall: THE SYSTEM SHALL emit a JSON object with commands.len() == 30 (matching master §33.3)

unwanted.condition: IF a new CLI command is added but the agent-context JSON is not updated
unwanted.shall_not: THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT silently drop the new command; the proptest must fail (P1-21 catches the drift)
unwanted.because: AI agents reading the agent-context JSON rely on it as the source of truth; missing commands break automation

preconditions: Master §33.3 Lifecycle Command Surface is the source of truth for command names
args/constants.rs::VALID_COMMANDS is the source of truth for parse-time validation
postconditions: Each entry has at least: name, description, args (Vec<String>), examples (Vec<String>)
invariants: The set of command names in agent_context is a subset of VALID_COMMANDS
P1-21 (cli_matrix_conformance) locks down the cross-reference between Command enum, VALID_COMMANDS, parse_args, run_from_env, HELP, and agent_context

happy: agent_context_commands_length_is_30: `vb agent-context --deliver stdout | jq .commands | length` returns 30
agent_context_includes_all_8_new_commands: each of help, version, status, system-status, action list, action inspect, ai-context, cancel is present in the JSON
error: agent_context_with_duplicate_command_name_fails_to_compile: a duplicate entry in commands() is a compile error (use a const-set or HashSet check)
agent_context_with_31_entries_fails_proptest: a deliberate test that adds a 31st entry to commands() should fail the proptest constant check
agent_context_proptest_with_22_entries_fails: a deliberate test that reverts the constant to 22 (after the 30 bump) should fail
edge: agent_context_proptest_with_30_entries_passes: proptest constant updated to 30, runs 100 random subsets, all subsets are subsets of the 30

files: crates/vb_cli/src/lib.rs::Command (the Command enum, source of truth for names)
patterns: Pattern: existing command(...) literal in mod.rs:103-261 — copy the structure for each new entry
questions: Are there any commands that are not in master §33.3 but are still valid subcommands? (Spec: focus on the 8 missing ones; the master list is the source of truth.)

security_failures.prevention: P1-21 (cli_matrix_conformance) proptest cross-references every agent_context command against Command enum variants

usability_failures.failure: AI agent reads the agent-context JSON, sees 22 commands, doesn't know about `cancel` (master §33.3 mandates it)
usability_failures.prevention: Bump to 30; add the 8 missing commands

data_integrity_failures.failure: agent_context JSON is hand-edited and drifts from the Command enum
data_integrity_failures.prevention: P1-21 proptest locks it down; the test fails on drift

integration_failures.failure: An external tool (e.g., a docs generator) reads agent_context and produces 22 entries, missing 8
integration_failures.prevention: External tool sees the new 30; no further action needed
